What is the actual power output of the Revolution85+ ERV1020EWT power supply?

The rated power is 1020 watts. It delivers most of this power on the +12V rail, suitable for high-performance configurations.

Is this power supply compatible with my ATX motherboard?

Yes, it is compatible with ATX, EEB and CEB motherboards. It has a main 24-pin connector and a 8-pin (4+4) CPU connector. Check that your motherboard does not require -5V voltage (not supported).

- ENERMAX REVOLUTION85+ series is compliant with:

SSI PSDG 2008/2009 Power Supply Design Guide specification and downward compatible with SSI PSDG 2008 v1.0, EPS12V v2.92, v2.91 and v2.8

- This PSU does not support MB with ISA expansion slot, which might need -5V power. -5V has been cancelled from Intel ATX12V v1.3 specification onwards.
